# OxY — systems & infrastructure engineer

> Portfolio of OxY, an anonymous systems & infrastructure engineer: selected
> work, experience and credentials. Credibility artifact for recruiters and
> potential collaborators.

OxY is a systems & infrastructure engineer (anonymous by choice) working as an
apprentice Site Reliability Engineer at a CAC40 software group. He designs
systems that stay up when things go wrong: disaster-recovery orchestration,
zero-trust backup architectures, observability pipelines, and AI/agent
infrastructure.
